full_name: Ben Miller | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Ben Miller is the author of River Bend Chronicle: The Junkification of a Boyhood Idyll amid the Curious Glory of Urban Iowa (Lookout Books, 2013, photographs by Robert Campagna), a genre-extending collection of linked essays studying a talented but troubled family, their local landscape of five hilly cities clustered along the Mississippi River, and America in the 1970s and 1980s.
